comparison.calculator: O(count) pack/unpack, two halfword DMA spans require4*count bytes; no allocation.
comparison.model: Each step O(1), at most one PIO receive/write; independent memory acknowledgements; unresponsive hardware has no finite quiescence promise.
comparison.target: Fixed selected-register operations with memory barriers; no physical throughput or interrupt latency bound.
comparison.measurement: Host-only digital-trace uncertainty analysis; not a target runtime dependency.

limits: Emitted section sizes and compiler local frames are observed; local frames are not complete call-chain/interrupt peak stack.
No physical SPI waveform, DMA completion latency, energy or throughput measured.
Different optimization/targets require rebuilding; these are not portable golden costs.
